arguments.reason: Single informed length revision after the failed extended design (run_extend_v1: position_error 0.0263 m > 0.01 m tolerance, 35/35 updates stopped on feasibility with zero converged updates, sampled settling failed). Both lengths of build_extend_v1 are already pinned at their upper bounds (near 0.17, far 0.13), so extension cannot continue. Compared with the historical old-design reach (about 8.5 mm), the +20 mm total length increased error by about 17.8 mm, consistent with gravity-sag domination for a target 40 mm above the mount and with the bundled tension guess mismatching a deviating length. Shortening the proximal near segment by the smallest authorized meaningful amount (1 mm, to 0.159 m) reduces the moment arm that dominates whole-arm sag, keeps the far segment and every other frozen item untouched, and keeps the total arc long enough to span the about 0.29 m mount-to-target distance.
